title: Service Advisor - D. Open and fill an in-progress inspection
preconds: Logged in as Service Advisor. WO = View/Create&Edit (no WO Delete) but WOL = V/E/D -> full inspection rights follow the LINE (SV-8095). A line has an in-progress inspection (incl. on an approved line for Tech View roles).
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open an in-progress inspection on a line (click Open).
  3. Attempt to fill/edit the inspection items.
expected:
Step 2: The inspection opens.
Step 3: Inspection items can be filled/edited. (WOL Create and Edit - SV-8095 AC2.)
